grader: t3/evals/incidents.py:v4 (twin replay; kept iff no_action fails the tolerance at the grade step and the safety filter clipped nothing)
model_id: none (data generation: twin replay only, no model)

config.evidence_writer: tools/evlib.py: a local store in the job, uploaded and attested by tools/sm/entry.py
config.executed: SageMaker training job started by tools/sm/run.py on ml.m5.xlarge (x86_64): the platform of record for the suite; in-process twin (twin/, W2), no network twin
config.input: t3/evals/suite/candidates.jsonl: the 84 candidate specs (test_set_sha256 is its sha256); seeds 4100-4183, one per candidate
config.output: {output_dir}/suite: incidents-test.jsonl, incidents-dev.jsonl, incidents-test.sha256, incidents-meta.json (in the job's output.tar.gz)
config.records: one item per candidate (input = canonical candidate spec, output = canonical incident or drop record) and a result with n_items == 84

runner.shipped: the committed tree at code_sha only (git archive); uncommitted changes never reach the job
